usefulness.rationale: The dossier contains no content at all — no narrative, no claims, no citations. A reader learns nothing beyond the bare identity anchors (name, birth date/place, current role, education), and even those arrive without any supporting source material. There is no account of what Barra has actually done, no discussion of her tenure, decisions, or accomplishments, and no indication of what the dossier does or does not know. It is impossible to prepare for a meeting from this. The two listed unjustified conclusions (ignition-recall, engineer-of-record) have no corresponding dossier statements to match, so no overclaims can be identified.
